name: Keep it Simple Sunday
notes:
Has moved to 10:00 AM (Winter schedule).

Keep It Simple Sunday (K.I.S.S.) is an outdoor meeting in Blain Park at 3101 South Court Street in Visalia. We meet down in the detention basin until 11:30 AM. It is a pet-friendly group. We form a circle and someone reads the Daily Reflections: that's the topic for the meeting. Our group has a lot of good long-term sobriety in it. Newcomers are welcome. BRING A LAWN CHAIR. We give out chips every Sunday for all sobriety milestones. Our business meeting is the first Sunday of the month, immediately after the meeting. We meet no matter the weather; if it’s raining, bring an umbrella.

name: Civic Center Group
notes:
We meet every Tuesday night at the Christ Lutheran church near Tulare and Demaree in Visalia. The meeting starts at 7:00 PM and goes to 8:15 PM. It is an open meeting, and newcomers are welcome. We have coffee and candy, and literature every week. Books are for sale at cost, and pamphlets are free. Our business meetings are the third Tuesday of the month at 8:15 PM, immediately after the meeting. We give out chips every week for sobriety under one year; we have a birthday meeting on the last Tuesday of the month, with cupcakes.

We're trying the slightly longer meeting time, beginning in April 2026. Please attend our business meeting if you want your opinion heard.
